easy: Asking people to give money for a good cause.

ex.en: Our school held a collection for the animal shelter.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 동물 보호소를 위해 모금을 했다.

easy: Going on without stopping.

ex.en: The continued rain flooded the playground.
ex.ko: 계속된 비로 운동장이 물에 잠겼다.

easy: Thought to be likely to come or happen.

ex.en: The expected storm reached us by night.
ex.ko: 예상했던 폭풍이 밤에 우리에게 닥쳤다.

easy: The day after Thursday.

ex.en: We have pizza at school every Friday.
ex.ko: 우리는 금요일마다 학교에서 피자를 먹는다.

easy: Hard to lift because it weighs a lot.

ex.en: My backpack is heavy today.
ex.ko: 오늘 내 가방은 무겁다.

easy: More than usual.

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for school.
ex.ko: 교통 체증이 심해서 우리는 학교에 늦었다.

easy: What you know from learning and thinking.

ex.en: Reading gives you knowledge about the world.
ex.ko: 책을 읽으면 세상에 대한 지식을 얻는다.

easy: More than usual.

ex.en: It was particularly cold today.
ex.ko: 오늘은 특히 추웠다.

easy: Most of all, more than the others.

ex.en: I like animals, particularly dogs.
ex.ko: 나는 동물, 특히 개를 좋아한다.

easy: Looking carefully to find something or someone.

ex.en: Our search for the lost cat took all afternoon.
ex.ko: 잃어버린 고양이를 찾는 데 오후 내내 걸렸다.

easy: To teach someone so well that they get really good.

ex.en: My coach trains young swimmers.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 어린 수영 선수들을 훈련시킨다.

easy: To learn and practice to get ready for a job.

ex.en: My aunt is training to be a nurse.
ex.ko: 이모는 간호사가 되려고 훈련받고 있다.

easy: To teach a pet or child how to act well.

ex.en: We train our puppy to sit.
ex.ko: 우리는 강아지에게 앉는 법을 훈련시킨다.

easy: Big from one side to the other.

ex.en: The river is very wide here.
ex.ko: 이곳에서는 강이 아주 넓다.

easy: Opened all the way.

ex.en: The baby looked at the balloon with wide eyes.
ex.ko: 아기는 풍선을 크게 뜬 눈으로 바라봤다.

easy: To make people feel amazed.

ex.en: The magician wowed the whole class.
ex.ko: 마술사는 반 전체를 감탄시켰다.

easy: The middle point of something.

ex.en: Put the cookie in the center of the plate.
ex.ko: 쿠키를 접시 한가운데에 놓아라.

easy: A place where many people go to do one kind of thing.

ex.en: We go swimming at the community center.
ex.ko: 우리는 주민 센터에서 수영을 한다.

easy: An easy, friendly word for father.

ex.en: My dad makes pancakes on Sundays.
ex.ko: 아빠는 일요일마다 팬케이크를 만들어 주신다.

easy: Grown or made better over time.

ex.en: She has a well developed sense of humor.
ex.ko: 그녀는 유머 감각이 잘 발달해 있다.
